## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and related issue, if any.

## Verification

List the checks run and their results. For UI changes, include synthetic examples in both themes, both languages and at phone width. Note any checks you could not run.

## Review

- [ ] Tests cover behavior that changed; required checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation and the PR description reflect the final change.
- [ ] The diff and attachments contain no credentials, visitor data or private deployment details.
- [ ] Schema changes use a new migration tested on a disposable database, or no schema change is involved.
- [ ] Dependency changes retain required notices and have been reviewed for license and security changes, or no dependencies changed.
